observed_so_far: Only new-runtime original-task references have run: four existing sources, 69 continuous steps and 138 exact-start restored steps PASS. No serving outcome was observed when writing this contract.
technical_gate: Source/config/entrypoint/original-task/receipt/Consumer/physical-resource accounting correctness. SLO misses, zero reuse, ties, drift above 2 percent and low opportunity are retained outcomes, not technical failures.
pilot_scope: 24 fixed cells: two existing speakers, five primary plus strict-birth auxiliary arms, two fresh repeats. Complete this technical matrix unless a genuine identity/correctness/resource-integrity defect requires preserved diagnosis.

inflight_vs_ready_only.count: unique originally speculative jobs whose complete input becomes the actual parent while original model inference is still active and before Owner has admitted a complete receipt
inflight_vs_ready_only.minimal_activation_for_expansion: at least one genuine model-active compatible handover in each of the two pilot speaker groups across its two repeats
inflight_vs_ready_only.threshold_meaning: minimum mechanism activation, not a power calculation or a claim that a null performance result is inconclusive

dependency_versioned_vs_fullcall.count: actual decision points where an earlier frozen ancestor has been refuted but this job's complete start has not been refuted, distinguishing pending from currently confirmed; separately count later legally installed retained jobs
dependency_versioned_vs_fullcall.minimal_activation_for_unique_increment_: at least one treatment-discriminating ancestor-fence versus complete-input-retain decision in each pilot speaker group
dependency_versioned_vs_fullcall.important: ordinary direct compatible handovers may be retained by BOTH policies. Ninety-two historical promotions are not ninety-two dependency-versioned disagreements. Same version with different input is not the required discriminator.
dependency_versioned_vs_fullcall.shadow_scope: a predicate applied to an actual frozen decision state can identify an opportunity; it is not a replayed alternative schedule or an audio-second counterfactual

early_retirement_vs_uir.minimal_activation_for_increment_expansi: observed useful before-C exit opportunity in each pilot speaker group; distinguish proof timing that is too late or not directly measured
early_retirement_vs_uir.tie: a tie after real cancellation opportunity can show no incremental service benefit. UIR retains end-use checks and therefore cannot show them redundant. The current safe UIR also retains classification for diagnostics, so it is not an experiment removing classification overhead.

counts: delivered supported coverage and gap area
view_support.role: diagnose actual support opportunity in native runs. SUP is fixed across these five arms; its independent increment is not identified by these five contrasts. Existing strict R by S evidence supplies that separate comparison.
view_support.native_SUP_extension_gate: only propose a separately frozen same-native-task support ablation if real compatible-ahead opportunities justify it; do not attribute common SUP benefit to an EL contrast

ready_inventory.count: Owner-admitted complete full-receipt bank hits before actual Reconciler.install, using serial sequence and all original timing fields
ready_inventory.zero: valid if in-flight opportunities dominate. Zero neither invalidates the arm nor proves equivalence to Conservative. Diagnose ready arrivals, fences, speculative displays and redispatch.

decision_table.condition: real decision disagreement and stable fullcall benefit over dependency_versioned
decision_table.action: expand the specific contrast and quantify paired audio-second/resource effects; claim a measured conditional increment, not universal superiority or an external-system reproduction

decision_table.condition: fullcall and dependency_versioned close with substantial legal-ahead execution, both better than Conservative
decision_table.action: report that the simpler representation suffices on this contract. Retain legal early-execution and joint compute/view findings; do not infer that the entire authors' joint design already existed elsewhere

decision_table.condition: UIR and fullcall close after useful early-exit opportunity
decision_table.action: report no established incremental retirement benefit in this workload, preserve costs and exact use guards; do not call complete-input/AU checks redundant

decision_table.condition: substantial treatment-discriminating opportunities but no service separation
decision_table.action: accept a genuine null or simpler-policy sufficiency result; do not relabel it low density and keep changing workloads until fullcall wins

retain the whole pilot and diagnose that particular contrast. At most two separately declared development timing/length points may be studied; choose by opportunity, never by favorable latency. No automatic full bank or additional repeats of an inactive comparison.

decision_table.condition: canonical demand fills both workers in the fixed 2/4-session resource phase
decision_table.action: zero speculation and convergence are legitimate resource-allocation boundary evidence, not a failed pilot or a prompt to tune until separation

bounded_followups_if_inactive.first_candidate: natural 12-20 second whole utterances, preserving 500ms frontiers. Select by metadata/header only; paired shorter utterances within the same development speakers where available; no outcome-based clip replacement
bounded_followups_if_inactive.second_candidate: a separately frozen bounded selected-feedback/receipt timing stress, if needed to calibrate real ready-bank activation; exact delay and mechanism must be declared before execution, unchanged original task and D2/C8 clock, explicitly controlled timing rather than natural prevalence
bounded_followups_if_inactive.cadence: no tighter revisions in the primary 500ms contract. A different cadence requires a distinct design and result stratum
bounded_followups_if_inactive.selection_and_confirmation: development opportunity-driven point selection is disclosed; freeze before confirmation on untouched sources. Existing repeated voices add no new acoustic sample. All attempted points and failures remain archived.

service_decomposition.allowed: paired same-task same-resource policy contrasts in audio-seconds, plus actual decision/cost ledgers and the separately identified R by S interaction
service_decomposition.not_identified: a unique additive number of audio-seconds for every internal check. The five-arm design is not a full factorial; scheduling and retention interactions cannot be allocated by summing per-job overlap or arm differences
service_decomposition.version_and_input: a version identity bound to a complete certified input may implement an input witness. The disputed rule is coarse birth/ancestor revocation, not every possible use of versions

measurement_contract.readiness: validated complete receipt admitted by Owner before actual install, not physical model_end or socket arrival
measurement_contract.frontier: 16kHz, full steps8000 samples, original partial EOS, all lengths unchanged
measurement_contract.redispatch: record per-job starts and frozen input/target, reissues, cancellation terminal, rerun worker/infer wall, all pending/lifecycle states and final drain closure
measurement_contract.energy: both boards, original origin through confirmed physical drain; detect unrelated GPU owners and mark affected energy unverifiable without deleting correctness/latency/failure evidence
measurement_contract.failures: all preselected offered input remains denominator. No best-run replacement; preserved technical failures are diagnosed under same-input/repeat/original controls before a new version
measurement_contract.units: speaker clusters and repeat structure explicit. Worker wall is not GPU active time; reanalysis is not a new serving run

budget.next: observe the first actual cell's inclusive load-to-physical-release wall time inside the fixed24-cell pilot to estimate remaining cost and decide later bank expansion; no guessed loading-time estimate and no extra best-run replacement. Complete the pilot absent a genuine technical defect.
budget.resource_control: 8 targeted grouped cells before a large source expansion
budget.existing_eight: 96 total =80 primary+16 auxiliary, conditional on useful unanswered mechanism questions; reused development voices identified
budget.new_independent: 10*N only under a separately justified confirmation gate and metadata/header/history selection, never assume N16 or run160 automatically
